sentence_1_it: La fortezza era nelle mani del nemico.
sentence_1_en: The fortress was in the enemy's hands.
sentence_2_it: Dal momento che nella fortezza mancavano i viveri, i suoi difensori dovettero arrendersi.
sentence_2_en: From the moment that the fortress ran out of supplies, its defenders had to surrender.
sentence_3_it: Essendo la fortezza a corto di viveri, i difensori dovettero arrendersi.
sentence_3_en: The fortress being out of supplies, its protectors had to give up.
